title: GATE 2027 official website (IIT Madras)
why: Canonical source for dates, eligibility, application, syllabus and notifications. Check before trusting any secondary source.

title: GATE 2027 papers & revised syllabi
why: Download the edition-specific syllabus PDF for your paper. GATE 2027 syllabi were revised — do not use old PDFs.

title: NPTEL / SWAYAM free engineering courses
why: Start with 1 primary lecture series per subject. NPTEL courses map well to GATE fundamentals and are free to watch.

title: NPTEL Operating Systems (example: start here for CS OS)
subject: Operating Systems
why: Useful for beginners for OS concepts; pair with practice on this site. Verify the link still resolves before exams.

title: GeeksforGeks GATE CS preparation
why: Quick reference and topic-wise notes for revision. Cross-check tricky claims with standard books.

title: Standard textbooks via your college library
why: One standard book per subject beats ten PDFs. Use the National Digital Library or your college library for legal free access.

title: Official GATE question papers (previous years)
why: Prefer official papers when available. This site links to official sources rather than republishing papers with unclear rights.
